notes: tapFrac is computed from each target's real rect, never estimated. Panel space is 1242x2688 (the panels hang under an AspectRatioFitter locked to that), and the canvas resolves to 1242x2760 on a 1080x2400 device, so the conversion is tapFracX = panelX / 1242 and tapFracY = (36 + (2688 - panelY)) / 2760.
